hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880305 (13 public Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 124 list 30-amp; no full-hookup site type), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 201 campsites in two areas, including seven walk-in tent sites beside Area B, 'from a small tent to a large motor home'. The booking site lists 197 (172 Modern Electric, 25 Modern Non-Electric). Listed max vehicle lengths run 15 to 55 ft, about 63 sites take 40 ft or more; three Area B sites (180, 184, 195) are pull-through. Pets on designated sites. Courtesy boat mooring for registered campers.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cowans-gap-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880305 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Site Access) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cowans-gap-state-park/stay ('Cowans Gap has 201 campsites in two areas'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cowans-gap-state-park/stay ('a sanitary dump station and modern restrooms with flush toilets and warm showers'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cowans-gap-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880305 (Booking Window for Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric, Modern Tent Only: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (mid-April to mid-December, which DCNR still states). Added 50-amp electric (13 sites; most are 30), 201 campsites up to 55 ft with three pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump. No full-hookup sites on the booking site, but water/sewer at the site are not stated either way, so left unknown. RA tags only the group tenting area and a pavilion 'Waterfront', no campsite. Not stated: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
